race.comment: JUST YES (5) jumped a $1.24 chance last start, sitting handy and running away for a dominant win at Northam when over the mile for the first time. Out further now won't be an issue and he looks a very progressive gelding on the rise. Plenty of upside and can repeat the dose. KING OF THE TOWN (3) just missed in a photo finish first-up over 1650m at Belmont and now gets CJP on board. He jumped favourite there and is open to plenty of improvement after being caught wide and without cover. Can roll forward which is a big tick for his chances and be there when it matters most. MONTY ZOOMER (1) disappointed last start behind Opportunistic but was in better touch prior. Drawn nicely and can bounce back to his best. Leading chance. ABISSI (7) draws much better today as he drops in trip and he can put his best foot forward. WILD THINGS (4) has to be included on his form.
